issue_context.title: Dynamic imports in worker fail build
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

When building a Vite project with web workers and the workers using dynamic import, building it fails with the following rollup error.

```
[vite:worker] Invalid value "iife" for option "output.format" - UMD and IIFE output formats are not supported for code-splitting builds.
file: /vanillajs__vite/src/my.worker.js?worker
error during build:
```

### Reproduction

To reproduce create web worker with following code:

```js
// my-worker.worker.js
import('lodash').then(r => console.log(r))
```

```js
// app.js
import Worker from './my-worker.worker?worker';

new Worker();
```

### System Info

```shell
System:
    OS: macOS 11.6
    CPU: (8) arm64 Apple M1
    Memory: 117.03 MB / 16.00 GB
    Shell: 5.8 - /bin/zsh
  Binaries:
    Node: 16.0.0 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v16.0.0/bin/node
    Yarn: 1.22.10 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v16.0.0/bin/yarn
    npm: 7.10.0 - ~/.nvm/versions/node/v16.0.0/bin/npm

    Edge: 94.0.992.50

```
```
